lookupStatus.description: Whether the tweet was found or unavailable.

handle.description: X screen name (handle) without the leading @.

displayName.description: Display name shown on the profile.

avatarUrl.description: Best available square avatar image URL.

verified.description: Whether X marks the profile with legacy verification (not necessarily paid blue).

blueVerified.description: Whether the account has X blue (paid) verification.

handles.description: Per-service handles when any are present.
